scanNote: 21-mashqda jadvaldagi qalin variantlardan qaysi biri tagiga chizilishi kassetada aniqlanadi. 'Type' qatorini taomlardan aniq topish mumkin (Hawaiian). Qolgan qatorlar uchun eng mantiqiy variant va sabab berilgan, audio talab qilishi alohida ko'rsatilgan.

sections.title: At the restaurant — a full dialogue

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and fill in the missing words, then listen and check. Listen again and follow the text, then read out the dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tinglab tekshiring. Yana tinglab matnni kuzatib boring, so'ng dialoglarni ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RESTORANDAGI TO'LIQ DIALOG — TO'RT BOSQICH:

  1-bosqich: KELISH va JOYLASHISH
  2-bosqich: BUYURTMA BERISH
  3-bosqich: OVQAT HAQIDA GAPLASHISH
  4-bosqich: HISOB SO'RASH

QAHRAMONLAR:
  W = the waiter (ofitsiant)
  M = the man (erkak)
  L = the lady (ayol)

MUROJAAT SHAKLLARI:
  sir /sɜː/    — janob (erkakka)
  madam /ˈmædəm/ — xonim (ayolga)
Bu so'zlar restoran, do'kon va mehmonxonada ishlatiladi.

lines.textEn: Good evening, sir. Table for two?
1) ............ you like to look at the menu?
lines.whyUz:
'WOULD you like to ...?' = ...moqchimisiz? (muloyim taklif).
'Do you like' XATO — bu 'yoqtirasizmi?' degan boshqa savol.

lines.textEn: May I take your order, please?
Yes. To start with I 2) ............ the tomato soup.
lines.whyUz:
'I'D LIKE' = I WOULD like = men ... olsam deb edim.
'To start with' = birinchi taom sifatida (starter).

lines.textEn: Tomato soup for me, too, please.
Certainly. And for the main course?
And the roast chicken for me, please.
I'm sorry, madam. There's no more roast chicken tonight.
Oh. 3) ............ I have a pepper steak, then?
lines.whyUz:
'CAN I have ...?' — ILTIMOS (request) savoli.
'COULD I have ...?' ham to'g'ri va MULOYIMROQ.
'then' bu yerda = unda, u holda.

lines.textEn: Of course. 4) ............ you like something to drink?
lines.whyUz:
'WOULD you like ...?' — taklif (offer).
'something to drink' = ichgani biror narsa.

'water' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a water' XATO.
ILTIMOSDA SOME ishlatiladi (57-betdagi qoida).
'Just' = shunchaki, faqat.

lines.textEn: Very well. Would you like to order your dessert, now?

lines.whyUz:
'I'D LIKE the apple pie.' — buyurtma berish qolipi.
'the' — menyudagi ANIQ taom.

MA'LUMOT so'rash savolida ANY (57-betdagi qoida).
Bu taklif ham, iltimos ham emas — bor-yo'qligi so'ralyapti.

lines.textEn: I'm sorry, we haven't. Would you like something else instead?

lines.whyUz:
'WHAT about ...?' = ...-chi? (savolni boshqasiga o'tkazish).
'How about ...?' ham to'g'ri, lekin bu yerda 'What about'
chunki oldingi savol 'How is your fish?' bo'lgan.

lines.textEn: A bit tough, but the sauce is nice.

lines.whyUz:
'CAN we have the bill, please?' — hisob so'rash qolipi.
'COULD we ...?' va 'MAY we ...?' ham to'g'ri (muloyimroq).
'the bill' = hisob (britancha); amerikacha 'the check'.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the restaurant phrases from the dialogue.
exercises.explanationUz:
RESTORANDAGI IBORALAR — KIM AYTADI?

OFITSIANT (waiter) aytadi:
  Good evening, sir/madam.
  Table for two?
  This way, please.
  Would you like to look at the menu?
  May I take your order, please?
  And for the main course?
  Certainly. / Very well. / Of course.
  I'm sorry, there's no more ...
  Would you like something else instead?
  Is everything all right?
  One moment ...

MIJOZ (customer) aytadi:
  Yes, please.
  To start with I'd like ...
  I'd like the ...
  Can I have ... , then?
  Just some water, please.
  Have you got any ...?
  Can we have the bill, please?

sentences.noteUz:
OFITSIANT. To'liq shakli: 'Do you want a table for two?'
Qisqartirilgan savol — restoranda odatiy.

OFITSIANT. Yo'l ko'rsatganda aytiladi.
'this way' = bu tomonga.

sentences.en: May I take your order, please?
sentences.noteUz:
OFITSIANT. 'May I ...?' — eng rasmiy ruxsat so'rash.
'an order' = buyurtma.

sentences.en: To start with I'd like the tomato soup.
sentences.uz: Birinchi taom sifatida pomidor sho'rvasi olsam deb edim.
sentences.noteUz:
MIJOZ. 'to start with' = birinchi navbatda, boshlash uchun.
'a starter' = birinchi taom.

OFITSIANT. 'the main course' = asosiy (ikkinchi) taom.
55-betdagi jadvalda ham bor edi.

sentences.en: There's no more roast chicken tonight.
sentences.noteUz:
OFITSIANT. 'no more' = boshqa yo'q, tugadi.
'tonight' = bugun kechqurun.

sentences.en: Would you like something else instead?
sentences.noteUz:
OFITSIANT. 'something else' = boshqa biror narsa.
'instead' = o'rniga (57-betda ham bor edi).

sentences.en: A bit tough, but the sauce is nice.
sentences.noteUz:
MIJOZ. 'a bit' = biroz (yumshatuvchi).
'tough' /tʌf/ = qattiq (go'sht haqida) — 'gh' o'qilmaydi!
Aksi: 'tender' (yumshoq).

sentences.en: Can we have the bill, please?
sentences.noteUz:
MIJOZ. 'the bill' = hisob (britancha).
Amerikacha: 'the check'.
Ovqat oxirida aytiladi.

OFITSIANT. 'Just a moment' ham to'g'ri.
Kutishni so'rash iborasi.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in teams. Take it in turns to choose words/phrases from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Jamoa bo'lib ishlang. Navbatma-navbat ro'yxatdan so'z yoki iborani tanlab, gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochkoli jamoa g'olib bo'ladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'YIN SO'ZLARI (14 ta) — butun 8-unit lug'ati:
  how much, delicious, dessert, how many, helpful waiters,
  home-made, have dinner, lunch, cut food, choose from,
  I'd like, any, something else, tough steak

QOIDALAR:
  • Ikki jamoaga bo'linasiz
  • Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'z tanlaysiz
  • O'sha so'z bilan TO'G'RI gap tuzasiz
  • Har bir to'g'ri gap — 1 ochko
  • Ko'p ochkoli jamoa g'olib

Quyida har bir so'z uchun namuna gap berilgan.

modelSentences.sentence: How much milk do you need?
For dessert, I'd like a slice of apple pie.
How many eggs does she need?
The service is excellent, with very helpful waiters.
Don't miss the chance to try our home-made bread.
Brazilians have dinner very late, at about ten o'clock at night.
modelSentences.uz: 'kechki ovqat qilmoq' iborasi bilan gap tuzing

modelSentences.sentence: The restaurant is open for lunch and dinner every day.
We cut food with a knife.
There are a lot of tasty dishes to choose from.
I'd like the grilled fish, please.
modelSentences.uz: 'men ... olsam deb edim' iborasi bilan gap tuzing

modelSentences.sentence: Would you like something else instead?
modelSentences.uz: 'boshqa biror narsa' iborasi bilan savol tuzing

modelSentences.sentence: The steak is a bit tough, but the sauce is nice.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Yana tinglab, takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'PLIK -S QO'ShIMCHASI UCH XIL O'QILADI.
QAYSI TOVUSH — SO'ZNING OXIRGI TOVUSHIGA BOG'LIQ:

  /ɪz/ — SIZILDOQ tovushdan keyin
         /s/, /z/, /ʃ/, /ʒ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/
         glassES, sandwichES, boxES, watchES, bridgES
         (qo'shimcha BO'G'IN qo'shiladi!)

  /s/  — JARANGSIZ undoshdan keyin
         /p/, /t/, /k/, /f/, /θ/
         cakeS, carrotS, bookS, cupS, cats

  /z/  — JARANGLI undosh va UNLIdan keyin
         /b/, /d/, /g/, /v/, /m/, /n/, /l/, /r/ va unlilar
         loaveS, cherrieS, dogS, penS, boyS

QANDAY TEKSHIRISH:
  Bo'g'in qo'shildimi? → /ɪz/
  Qo'shilmagan bo'lsa, oxirgi tovush jarangsizmi? → /s/
  Jaranglimi yoki unlimi? → /z/

BU QOIDA fe'lning 3-shaxs -S qo'shimchasiga ham tegishli:
  works /s/, plays /z/, watches /ɪz/

items.whyUz:
loaf → loaves. Oxirgi tovush /v/ JARANGLI → /z/.
O'qilishi: /ləʊvz/.
DIQQAT: 'f' → 'v' ga aylandi (56-betdagi qoida).

glass /ɡlɑːs/ — oxirgi tovush /s/ SIZILDOQ → /ɪz/.
O'qilishi: /ˈɡlɑːsɪz/ — QO'ShIMCHA BO'G'IN qo'shildi.

sandwich — oxirgi tovush /tʃ/ SIZILDOQ → /ɪz/.
O'qilishi: /ˈsænwɪdʒɪz/ — qo'shimcha bo'g'in.
DIQQAT: 'sandwich' da 'd' ko'pincha O'QILMAYDI.

cherry → cherries. Oxiri UNLI tovush → /z/.
O'qilishi: /ˈtʃeriz/.
DIQQAT: yozilishida 'ies' bo'lsa ham, qo'shimcha bo'g'in QO'ShILMAYDI.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and underline the correct items in bold in the table below. Then, use the notes to talk about the restaurant.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va quyidagi jadvaldagi qalin variantlardan to'g'risining tagiga chizing. So'ng qaydlardan foydalanib restoran haqida gapiring.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Qalin variantlardan qaysi biri to'g'ri ekani kassetada aytiladi. 'Type' qatorini jadvaldagi TAOMLAR bo'yicha aniq topish mumkin; qolganlari uchun eng mantiqiy variant va sabab berilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL — 'The Blue Lagoon' RESTORANI:

  Name:              The Blue Lagoon
  Type:              Chinese / Hawaiian
  Location:          Long / Short Street
  Main Course:       fresh fish / meat dishes,
                     Hawaiian burgers with pineapple
  Desserts:          coconut ice-cream / milk,
                     fried bananas in honey
  Cost:              £50 / £30 for two people
  Service:           excellent
  Opening hours:     2 pm – 10 pm / 12 am
  Recommendation:    very nice restaurant for the whole
                     family, book a table

Bu jadval 55-betdagi 'Laura's' jadvali bilan bir xil —
yozma ish (advertisement) uchun REJA bo'ladi.

DIQQAT — VAQT:
  2 pm = kunduzi soat 2 (14:00)
  10 pm = kechqurun soat 10 (22:00)
  12 am = yarim tun (00:00)
  'am' = tundan tushgacha; 'pm' = tushdan tungacha.

items.whyUz:
TAOMLARDAN ANIQ TOPILADI (audio kerak emas):
  'HAWAIIAN burgers with pineapple'
  'COCONUT ice-cream'
  'fried BANANAS in honey'
Ananas, kokos va banan — tropik mahsulotlar → GAVAYI oshxonasi.
Restoran nomi ham shunga ishora qiladi: 'The Blue Lagoon' (Ko'k laguna).

items.textEn: Main Course: fresh fish / meat dishes
items.whyUz:
AUDIO talab qiladi, lekin mantiq FISH tomonda:
Gavayi — orollar, dengiz mahsulotlari asosiy taom.
'fresh fish dishes' = yangi baliq taomlari.

AUDIO talab qiladi, lekin mantiq ICE-CREAM tomonda:
qator sarlavhasi 'DESSERTS' — 'coconut milk' ichimlik/masalliq,
'coconut ice-cream' esa SHIRINLIK.

AUDIO talab qiladi.
Tavsiyada 'very nice restaurant for the WHOLE FAMILY' deyilgan —
oilaviy restoran odatda arzonroq bo'ladi.
Qiyoslash: 'Laura's' da ikki kishilik ovqat £25 edi (55-bet).

AUDIO talab qiladi.
'12 am' = yarim tun — restoranlar uchun odatiy yopilish vaqti.
'2 pm – 12 am' = kunduzi soat 2 dan yarim tungacha.

AUDIO talab qiladi — bu qatorni matndan aniqlab bo'lmaydi.
Ikkala variant ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri.
Tinglaganda ko'cha nomini diqqat bilan eshiting.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, use the notes to talk about the restaurant.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng qaydlardan foydalanib restoran haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Jadvaldagi har bir qatorni gapga aylantiring —
55-betdagi 'Laura's' haqidagi nutq bilan bir xil usul.

example.speaker: 1-gap
example.en: The Blue Lagoon is a Hawaiian restaurant on Long Street.
example.uz: 'The Blue Lagoon' — Long ko'chasidagi Gavayi restorani.

example.speaker: 2-gap
example.en: You can have fresh fish dishes and Hawaiian burgers with pineapple.
example.uz: U yerda yangi baliq taomlari va ananasli gavayi burgerlarini olsangiz bo'ladi.

example.speaker: 3-gap
example.en: For dessert, there is coconut ice-cream and fried bananas in honey.
example.uz: Shirinlikka kokosli muzqaymoq va asalda qovurilgan banan bor.

example.speaker: 4-gap
example.en: A meal for two people costs about £30.
example.uz: Ikki kishilik ovqat taxminan 30 funt turadi.

example.speaker: 6-gap
example.en: It is open from two in the afternoon till twelve at night.
example.uz: U kunduzi soat ikkidan tunggi o'n ikkigacha ochiq.

example.speaker: 7-gap
example.en: It is a very nice restaurant for the whole family, but don't forget to book a table.
example.uz: Bu butun oila uchun juda yaxshi restoran, lekin stol band qilishni unutmang.

sections.title: Writing — an advertisement for a restaurant

exercises.instructionEn: Use the plan below and the information from Ex. 21 to complete the advertisement for The Blue Lagoon in the Photo File section.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi reja va 21-mashqdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib, Photo File bo'limidagi 'The Blue Lagoon' reklamasini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA (to'rt xatboshi):

  Para 1: name of restaurant, type & location
          (restoran nomi, turi va joyi)
  Para 2: dishes & desserts
          (taomlar va shirinliklar)
  Para 3: cost, service and opening hours
          (narx, xizmat va ish vaqti)
  Para 4: recommendation
          (tavsiya)

NAMUNA: 55-betdagi 'Laura's' taqrizi — u ham AYNAN
shu to'rt qismdan iborat.

FOYDALI IBORALAR (55-betdan):
  X is the new ... restaurant on ... Street.
  There are a lot of tasty dishes to choose from, such as ...
  Don't miss the chance to try ...
  For dessert, have ...
  A meal for two people costs about ...
  The service is excellent, with ... waiters.
  The restaurant is open from ... till ...
  ... , so don't forget to book a table first.

structure.modelEn: The Blue Lagoon is a new Hawaiian restaurant on Long Street.
structure.noteUz: 55-betdagi qolip: 'X is the new ... restaurant on ... Street.'

structure.modelEn: There are a lot of tasty dishes to choose from, such as fresh fish dishes and Hawaiian burgers with pineapple.
structure.noteUz: 'such as' — misol keltirish (55 va 58-betlarda ham bor).

structure.modelEn: For dessert, don't miss the chance to try our coconut ice-cream or fried bananas in honey.
structure.noteUz: 'Don't miss the chance TO + fe'l' — reklama iborasi (55-bet).

structure.modelEn: A meal for two people costs about £30.
The service is excellent, with very helpful and friendly waiters.
The restaurant is open from two in the afternoon till twelve at night.
The Blue Lagoon is a very nice restaurant for the whole family, but it is very busy, so don't forget to book a table first.
structure.noteUz:
'the whole family' = butun oila.
'don't forget TO + fe'l' — 55-betdagi qolip.

structure.modelEn: The Blue Lagoon is a new Hawaiian restaurant on Long Street. There are a lot of tasty dishes to choose from, such as fresh fish dishes and Hawaiian burgers with pineapple. For dessert, don't miss the chance to try our coconut ice-cream or fried bananas in honey. A meal for two people costs about £30. The service is excellent, with very helpful and friendly waiters. The restaurant is open from two in the afternoon till twelve at night. The Blue Lagoon is a very nice restaurant for the whole family, but it is very busy, so don't forget to book a table first.
structure.noteUz:
To'rt xatboshi, taxminan 95 so'z —
55-betdagi 'Laura's' taqrizi bilan bir xil tuzilish.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Uchta ingliz maqoli — hammasi OVQAT haqida,
lekin ma'nosi ovqatdan kengroq.

items.en: Man cannot live by bread alone.
items.uz:
So'zma-so'z: Odam faqat non bilan yashay olmaydi.

MA'NOSI: Insonga faqat moddiy narsalar (ovqat, pul) yetarli
emas — unga ma'naviy oziq ham kerak: bilim, sevgi, do'stlik,
san'at, e'tiqod.

KELIB CHIQISHI: Bibliyadan olingan ibora.

O'ZBEKCHA MUQOBILI:
  'Odam non bilangina tirik emas.'

LUG'AT:
  'man' bu yerda = INSON (umuman), erkak emas
  'alone' = faqat, yolg'iz
  'by' = bilan (vosita)

items.en: Eat to live, not live to eat.
items.uz:
So'zma-so'z: Yashash uchun yeng, yeyish uchun yashamang.

MA'NOSI: Ovqat — hayotning MAQSADI emas, VOSITASI.
Ovqatga haddan tashqari berilmaslik kerak.

GRAMMATIK QURILISH:
  'eat TO live'  = yashash uchun yemoq (maqsad)
  'live TO eat'  = yeyish uchun yashamoq
  Ikki fe'l O'RIN ALMASHTIRILGAN — shu bilan ma'no
  butunlay teskari bo'ladi.

O'ZBEKCHA MUQOBILI:
  'Yashash uchun yegin, yeyish uchun yashama.'

Bu maqol qadimgi yunon faylasufi Sokratga nisbat beriladi.

items.en: You can't make an omelette without breaking eggs.
items.uz:
So'zma-so'z: Tuxumni sindirmasdan omlet tayyorlab bo'lmaydi.

MA'NOSI: Biror natijaga erishish uchun qiyinchilikka va
yo'qotishga tayyor bo'lish kerak. Har qanday ishda ozgina
zarar yoki qurbonlik bo'ladi.

O'ZBEKCHA MUQOBILI:
  'Mehnatsiz rohat yo'q.'
  'Bergansiz olgan yo'q.'

LUG'AT:
  an omelette /ˈɒmlət/ = omlet
  without = ...siz, ...masdan
  to break = sindirmoq

GRAMMATIKA: 'without' dan keyin fe'l -ING bilan keladi:
  without BREAKING, without EATING, without SAYING.

items.derivedUz: b, d, g, v, m, n, l, r, unlilar
s, z, sh, ch, j, x

groups.explanationUz: 12 soatlik tizimda kunning qaysi yarmi ekanini bildiradi.
'without' dan keyin fe'l DOIM -ing bilan keladi.

items.derived: He went to school without eating breakfast.

patterns.formula: Would you like TO + fe'l? (muloyim taklif)
patterns.exampleEn: Would you like to look at the menu? Would you like to order your dessert now?
patterns.exampleUz: Menyuga qaramoqchimisiz? Shirinlikni hozir buyurtma qilmoqchimisiz?
patterns.explanationUz:
'Would you like TO + fe'l' — ish taklif qilish.
'Would you like + ot' — narsa taklif qilish.

patterns.formula: To start with, I'd like + taom.  /  I'd like the + taom.
patterns.exampleEn: To start with I'd like the tomato soup. I'd like the grilled fish.
patterns.exampleUz: Birinchi taomga pomidor sho'rvasi olsam. Men panjarada pishirilgan baliq olsam.
patterns.explanationUz:
'I'd like' = I WOULD like — buyurtma berishning asosiy qolipi.
Menyudagi aniq taom uchun 'THE' ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: Can I have + taom, then?  (birinchisi yo'q bo'lsa)
patterns.exampleEn: There's no more roast chicken. — Oh. Can I have a pepper steak, then?
patterns.exampleUz: Qovurilgan tovuq qolmadi. — Unda qalampirli bifshteks olsam bo'ladimi?

patterns.formula: Have you got ANY + ot?  — I'm sorry, we haven't.
patterns.exampleEn: Have you got any strawberries? — I'm sorry, we haven't.
patterns.explanationUz:
MA'LUMOT so'rash savolida ANY.
Qisqa javob: 'we haven't' (got takrorlanmaydi).

patterns.formula: Can we have the bill, please?
patterns.exampleEn: Can we have the bill, please? — Of course, sir. One moment ...
patterns.exampleUz: Hisobni olsak bo'ladimi? — Albatta, janob. Bir daqiqa ...

patterns.explanationUz: /ɪz/ da QO'ShIMCHA BO'G'IN qo'shiladi, qolgan ikkisida yo'q.

patterns.exampleEn: You can't make an omelette without breaking eggs.
